launcher.delete_confirm_sub: Permanently removes every stored session on this device
launcher.pause_sub: Stop recording until you resume it

notifications.delete_done_body: All recorded activity was removed from this device.

about.storage_body: Sessions are written locally to Noctalia's per-plugin data directory. Deleting the plugin keeps the data until you remove it from disk.
about.title: About & privacy
about.tracking_body: The service polls the compositor for the focused application. Idle time, screen lock, suspend and paused tracking are never counted. Nothing ever leaves this device: no network access, no telemetry, no analytics.
about.titles_body: Window titles can contain private information (documents, chats, URLs), so they are not recorded by default. Enable title tracking to store them locally alongside sessions.

delete.body: This permanently removes every recorded session from this device. It cannot be undone.
delete.title: Delete history

panel.empty_guide: Start using your computer and your activity will show up here.
panel.empty_hint: Your usage stays on this device.
panel.paused_day_hint: Nothing was recorded while tracking was paused.

retention_note.one: Sessions older than 1 day are removed automatically.
retention_note.other: Sessions older than {count} days are removed automatically.

panel.title: What Did I Do
panel.unavailable: Activity tracking is unavailable for this compositor.
panel.unavailable_body: Your existing history is still available.

glyph.description: Icon shown next to the tracked time in the bar.
glyph.label: Widget icon

history_retention_days.description: Delete stored sessions older than this many days. One day removes everything but today.
history_retention_days.label: Keep history for (days)

idle_after_seconds.description: Compositor idle time after which tracking pauses automatically (10-600 s).
idle_after_seconds.label: Count user as idle after (seconds)

persist_every_seconds.description: How often open sessions are flushed to disk (5-600 s).
persist_every_seconds.label: Save to disk every (seconds)

poll_interval.description: How often the focused application is sampled, in seconds (1-60).
poll_interval.label: Poll interval (seconds)

show_bar_widget.description: Hide the bar widget without removing it from your bar layout.
show_bar_widget.label: Show bar widget

show_glyph.description: Show the icon next to the tracked time.
show_glyph.label: Show icon

show_text.description: Show today's total time in the bar. Turn off for an icon-only widget.
show_text.label: Show time in bar

track_window_titles.description: Store window titles locally with each session. Titles can contain private information such as document names or chats.
track_window_titles.label: Track window titles

tracking_enabled.description: Record which application is focused. Existing history is kept when disabled.
tracking_enabled.label: Track activity
